outlook.statement: Global demand for copper continues to grow; demand increasing due to electric vehicle implementation, decarbonization policies, green energy emphasis, and antimicrobial properties of copper. Copper termed as new oil and core driver for net zero emissions.
India has very limited copper ore reserve (0.2% of world reserves), mining production 0.12% of world production, refined copper production about 2% of world production.
